profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer specializing in Embedded Systems - Turning problems into solutions
profile.summary:
Forward thinking Embedded Software Engineer with over 10 years of engineering experience. I help engineering and technology companies like Bosch and ZF launch embedded products such as Camera based Driver Assist and Smartphone Digital Car Key systems.
•	Developed and designed Backend communication application software component for smartphone digital key project to communicate with OEM Server.
•	Oversaw a team of 4 software engineers during the development and deployment of software updates leading to the successful transition of over 15 production platforms. 
•	Created a complete software solution for Petrojam Limited to integrate lab and process information to improve engineering efficiency. 
I get excited about opportunities where I can design and architect software while teaching young engineers.
I love connecting with new people, feel free to send me a message.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Create software requirements, designs, and code for Backend communication use cases for smartphone digital key project to communicate with OEM Server.
•	Develop and review software architecture designs for Vehicle Interface features to ensure architecture quality attributes are met.
•	Train and mentor software engineers on software development best practices to improve quality of software deliverables.
•	Consult with customers on system development and design to ensure complete and accurate customer and system requirements.
•	Collaborate with global project team to develop and deliver timely software for internal stakeholders.

positions.title: Embedded Software Engineer III – ADAS (Advanced Driver Assist Systems)
positions.description:
Perform integration, design and development activities for the Renault Nissan Mitsubishi Alliance (RNMA) AD1 project for the S-CAM4.8 Forward-Facing Camera. Lead Polyspace analysis for Farmington Hills ADAS Software Teams.
•	Design and develop functions to meet manufacturing, testing and validation requirements
•	Integrate core and 3rd party software into application software to meet system requirements
•	Work with international cross-functional team to implement features and troubleshoot hardware and software issues
•	Create software release documentation to meet software delivery for customer milestones
•	Lead static code analysis for project team and provided analysis tool support for local ADAS SW team
•	Adhere to company and industry standards including AUTOSAR, ISO 26262, ASPICE/SPICE to deliver quality software to customers

positions.title: Embedded Software Engineer II - ADAS (Advanced Driver Assist Systems)
positions.description:
Performed integration and development activities for Hyundai Kia Motor Company (HKMC) MOBIS running changes for the S-CAM3.5 Forward-Facing Camera.
•	Oversaw a team of 4 software engineers during the development and deployment of software updates leading to the successful transition of over 15 production platforms 
•	Implemented CANoe functionalities, updating panels and CAPL Script for product testing
•	Developed software tools to simplify, improve or shorten existing software processes
•	Ensured coding standards were met, quality assurance checks completed, also document, version and task management were performed prior to software release

projects.title: Autonomous Rain Gauge (Final Year Project)
projects.description:
Dramatic rainfall and the flooding which usually comes about due to its occurrence, has brought forward the need for a more widespread real time rainfall monitoring and measuring device. An engineering solution was designed and developed in the form of a network of devices, which were to be self-powered and self-controlled using a PIC microcontroller. The devices were to be able to be monitored remotely and provide an up to date status report of any area where an unusually high rainfall or flood water levels are occurring. A prototype was also developed which was successfully able to measure the flood water levels and rainfall and transmit the information to a base station.
•	Designed a solution to measure rainfall and flood water levels
•	Developed a working prototype using PIC microcontroller to measure desired information and transmit wirelessly to base station.

projects.title: Characterization of Dielectrics in Builds and Enhance our Understanding of  TDDB (IBM Research Project)
projects.description: Current methods of testing newly developed dielectrics can prove time consuming. The project was aimed towards exploring alternates to the current process of testing dielectrics. This was done by conducting a series of IV test using a wafer prober on multiple dielectric builds. During which, interesting behaviour noticed lead to further research to understand time dependent dielectric break down.  This involved the design of new tests and development of new programs to control the wafer prober. The results were then analysed.
